en: What appeared was one once hailed as a god of war.{w}{p}Fluttering both hands, it drew near with a genial smile.{w}{p}And what it reaps as it smiles... is lives.{w}
note: Master Drake (MONSTER3 epithet 'god of war'). Source is all-kana retro Wizardry pastiche (like 1748/1752); rendered in normal case -- ALL CAPS would be an option if the slice_021 row 1748 does the same.

en: Raging Figure
note: Unidentified-monster style name (Wizardry 'strange figure' convention), not a proper name.

en:
"Now then, you frail things.
Are you prepared?"{w}
You picked up an item.{w}
note: Kana-only retro variant of row 1731 (kanji version); same English.

en:
With a thudding tread that shook the ground,
a fat man came walking along.{w}
He seemed to be trying to perform some sort of ritual, but his bulging belly kept getting in the way.{w}
note: Don Magus (MONSTER3 epithet 'big-underpants magic').

en: The man noticed you watching.{w}Perhaps thinking you were mocking his portly body, he came charging at you, face beet red.{w}
Portly Man
"Hey! Who do you think I am!?"{w}
?Lady Doctor
note: Female doctor (MON_TEXT 276; Norden Orc entry, epithet 'Where shall I treat?'). '?' prefix kept as in other unidentified names.

en: "Next, please."{w}
Addressed out of nowhere, you were taken aback.{w}But pinned by her gaze, which allowed no argument, you somehow got the impression that you were the ones in the wrong.{w}
"So, what seems to be the trouble today?"{w}
At her prompting, you answered questions about your health. The doctor nodded languidly, writing up a chart with flowing strokes of her pen.{w}

"...All right, that's enough.
Now, bare your bottom. Get down on all fours.{w}I'm going to prescribe you a nice, big, heaping dose."{w}
note: Innuendo kept at full strength; per MON_TEXT her treatment is an injection with a huge syringe.

en: A woman appeared with a great many arrows nocked to a single bow.{w}She flitted lightly about the area.{w}Letting her beautiful hair play in the wind, she spoke.{w}
Bow Saint Polyte
note: Glossary spelling.

en:
"Morning dew is sweet nectar. Birdsong is the gospel.
The deep forest is the cradle of life.{w}And I am the Holy Polyte."{w}
note: 'Holy Polyte' matches the item name (seinaru Polyte no yumi) and rows 1768/1777.

en: Shooting Moon
note: Monster name (MONSTER2/MON_TEXT 231); this one is Jenas, Polyte's rival in the play 'Periatif'.

en: "Don't go calling yourself holy, it's embarrassing!"{w}
"Good day to you, Jenas."{w}
note: Polyte: posh, ladylike (watakushi / -desu wa).

en:
"Come on,
let's play out the rest of Periatif!"{w}
note: Periatif = the play about Polyte and Jenas's rivalry (MON_TEXT 227/231): i.e. resume their duel.

en: "...I'm not in the mood for that."{w}
"Why the hell not?"{w}
"Because I dislike you, naturally."{w}

"Well, it's not like I'm chasing after you
because I like it either!"{w}

"And what is that, with your bottom hanging out for all to see?
My, how vulgar."{w}

"You're one to talk,
using a bow like that! That's not real archery!"{w}
note: jado = heretical/improper way; refers to her firing many arrows at once.

en:
"You don't understand at all, do you, Jenas."{w}{p}"That's where you're supposed to say,
'As expected of the Holy Polyte!'"{w}
Jenas
note: New name. Female: uses atashi, Polyte calls her anata (kanji for a woman) and 'doe'.

en: "Shut the hell up!"{w}
Jenas turned to you with an irritated look, pleading her case.{w}

"...Hey, you get it, right?{w}Half the reason I want to kill her
is that personality! She makes no damn sense!!"{w}
note: 'Her' = Polyte (female established in row 1764).

en:
"I have never once asked you to understand me.
(Snap!~)"{w}
note: pishari = curt, slamming retort; the note symbol rendered as '~' (ASCII only).

en: "Aaaargh... You are so damn annoyiiing...!{w}Hey, let's kill her already!!"{w}
note: Jenas to the party: 'let's' -- she invites you to fight Polyte with her.

en: "How d'you like this, huh!?"{w}
"Thud, and down I go~{w}...or so I'd jest! Tee-hee..."{w}{p}"The Holy Polyte...!!"{w}
note: batankyu = cutesy 'keel over'. Final fragment is a cry that breaks off; 1786 is written to stand alone too.

en: "I won't go down from something like this!{w}I shall surely appear again! Appear in splendor!"{w}
"Shut that mouth of yours!{w}Seriously, you want me to kill you!?"{w}

"Jenas, you've improved.{w}{p}I'm off to hunt Demon Dukes,
so do mind things here while I'm away."{w}
note: daimakou -> 'Archdemon' (no prior rendering in the corpus; MON_TEXT says Polyte hunts them in the wasteland).

en: "Huh!? Don't just go deciding that on your own..."{w}

"Honestly, that Taizarti,
swallowing up so many of my arrows.{w}I must get them back as soon as possible."{w}{p}"Well then, good day!{w}...My little doe with the cute bottom~"{w}
note: Taizarti spelling from 'Taizarti Lamp' (chap slice_001). Per MON_TEXT 312 Polyte's arrows are stuck in Taizarti's head; no pronoun used (gender unknown).

en: "Eek!?"{w}

Polyte gave Jenas's rear a single stroke,
then ran off laughing.{w}
The Shooting Moon called Jenas stood quivering with rage she had nowhere to vent.{w}Her bottom was quivering too.{w}
Spiderwebs clung to your bodies.{w}The more you brushed them off, the more the threads tangled around you.{w}
It seems you noticed something was wrong a little too late.{w}{p}Before you knew it, you had been dragged into the nest of an enchantress in the shape of a spider.{w}
note: youjo -> 'enchantress' (a bewitching monster-woman).

en: Suddenly, you were wrapped in the scent of some flower.{w}I see -- this is no mere enchantress.{w}One cloaked in the scent of flowers... a FAIR enchantress!!{w}
note: bi-youjo (coined self-flattering word) -> 'fair enchantress', same word as the name box and row 1801.

en: ?Enchantress
note: 17 chars, one over the ~16 guideline; '?Fair Siren' is a shorter fallback.

en: "Rolfaaaaan!!"{w}
note: Taranti's battle cry (also her MONSTER3 epithet). Meaning unknown; romanized.

en: Taranti
note: New name (spider woman; tarantula pun).

en: "Hegyah!?"{w}{p}"Th... That's so mean...{w}Roughing up a fair enchantress like me...{w}...Waaaah!!"{w}
Taranti ran off, moving with something like a skip.{w}

Shaking heaven and earth, a grotesque, many-armed giant appeared.{w}It looked down at you and, amused by who knows what, rained down laughter like a thunderclap.{w}{p}But the next instant, the many-armed giant brought down a fist brimming with murderous intent.{w}
note: Hecatoncheir (not named in the text). 'nani ga tanoshii no ka' = for whatever reason it finds this fun; rendered as 'amused by who knows what'.

en: An unfamiliar knight of the Kin of Darkness appeared.{w}On a closer look she was a woman, and her dignified face showed iron resolve.{w}{p}Strength of heart becomes power.{w}From the Demon God Lance pointed at you, you sensed a blade of will honed to a terrifying edge.{w}
note: yami no kenzoku -> 'Dark Kin' (corpus is split: Dark Kin 5, Kin of Darkness 4, kin of darkness 4).

en: "My mother was betrayed by the gods and fell into darkness.{w}Even the small happiness she found after her fall had no future -- those of the New Lands stole her tomorrow."{w}{p}"And by the fate of all who side with darkness, my mother strayed from the Path of Souls and was swallowed up by the Abyss, that prison of souls."{w}
note: kami -> 'the gods' (number not marked). shinsouchi -> 'the New Lands' (new term). Speaker box is ??? (Sephiriege before she names herself).

en: Sephiriege
note: New name. Full Japanese box is 'Ankoku-metsu General Sephiriege'; the title is cut from the name box for length and is given in full in row 1807. Former name Sephirine (MON_TEXT 280).

en: "I am Sephiriege, Demon General of Dark Oblivion."{w}{p}"To save my mother's soul, and to bring an end to the injustice of the gods, I received a new name and power from Rogera."{w}{p}"The Demon God Lance will soon set out for the Abyss."{w}{p}"Should anyone stand in its way, whoever they may be...{w}even those who were once my brethren, I cannot spare them."{w}
note: anmetsu -> 'Oblivion' following Rogera's title in chap slice_008 / wmap slice_16. The lance line refers to herself through her weapon; kept.

en:
"Well, this is a surprise.
Though it has yet to fully settle in me, you've overcome power on par with a Divine Shadow?"{w}{p}"Perhaps we will meet again somewhere.{w}Heh heh heh..."{w}
note: shin'ei -> 'Divine Shadow' (wmap slice_01). 'it' = her newly granted power.

en: You saw a strange shadow ahead.{w}It seemed human-shaped, but its head was clearly wrong, writhing grotesquely.{w}{p}Soon the details of what had been shadow became clear.{w}You realized that where a human head should be, something else had been put in its place.{w}{p}How did you realize it?{w}Because the figure was closing in on you to attack.{w}
